params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Pyke}} gains {{as|{{sti|ad|attack damage}}}} equal to a portion of his {{as|{{sti|health|bonus health}}}}.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Pyke''' stores [[Health#Grey health|grey health]] when receiving damage from enemy {{tip|champions}}, increased if there are multiple nearby.
params.blurb3: '''Pyke''' can {{tip|heal}} himself by consuming grey health while hidden.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Pyke's''' {{sti|health|{{as|'''maximum''' health}}}} cannot increase except through [[Growth#Increasing_Statistics|growth (per level)]], instead he gains{{ft|{{sti|{{as|1 '''bonus''' attack damage}}}} {{as|per 14 '''bonus''' health}}.|{{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} equal to {{as|{{fd|7.143}}% of '''bonus''' health}}.}}
params.description2: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Pyke''' gains {{as|1 '''bonus''' movement speed}} while in the river.
params.description3: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Pyke''' stores 9% {{as|(+ {{fd|0.2}}% per 1 Lethality)}} of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} he takes from enemy {{tip|champions}} as [[Health#Grey health|grey health]] on his [[health bar]], increased to 40% {{as|(+ {{fd|0.4}}% per 1 Lethality)}} while there are two or more {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy champions nearby. He can store up to 80 {{as|(+ 800% '''bonus''' AD)}} [[Health#Grey health|grey health]], with an upper cap of {{as|55% of his '''maximum''' health}}.
params.description4: While '''Pyke''' is not {{tip|sight|visible}} to enemies, he rapidly consumes his [[Health#Grey health|grey health]] to {{tip|heal}} for the same amount.
params.notes:
* Game elements that increase health based on the champion's health (e.g {{ri|Overgrowth}}) will increase the health before getting converted by ''Gift of the Drowned Ones'', thus granting increased {{as|bonus AD}}.
* Pyke converts {{as|bonus health}} to {{as|bonus AD}} at a gold efficiency of {{fd|93.75}}%.
* {{ii|Spirit Visage}} and {{tip|Grievous Wounds}} take effect after ''Gift of the Drowned Ones's'' healing cap.
*'''Pyke's''' ''grey health'' does not have a time limit, and will stay on his {{as|health bar}} until '''Pyke''' leaves enemy vision or dies.
** However, if his combined {{as|'''current''' health}} and ''grey health'' would start to exceed {{as|100% of his '''maximum''' health}}, the excess ''grey health'' is lost.
* Since '''Pyke's''' '''maximum''' health cannot be increased, ''Gift of the Drowned Ones'' reaches the upper cap of {{as|55% of '''maximum''' health}} at {{pp|(0.6*({{ccd|Pyke|hp_base}}+{{ccd|Pyke|hp_lvl}}*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1)))-80)/8 for 20|color=ad}} {{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}.
* {{tip|Untargetable}} champions count towards '''Pyke's''' modified ''grey health'' storing.
* Amount of attack damage granted from list of items that grants health, converted with ''Gift of the Drowned Ones'':
{{Item stat table|pykehealth}}

blurb.plain: Innate: Pyke gains attack damage equal to a portion of his bonus health.

blurb2.plain: Innate: Pyke stores grey health when receiving damage from enemy champions, increased if there are multiple nearby.

blurb3.plain: Pyke can heal himself by consuming grey health while hidden.

blurb4.plain: Pyke's maximum health cannot increase except by leveling.

description.plain: Innate: Pyke's maximum health cannot increase except through growth (per level), instead he gains 1 bonus attack damage per 14 bonus health.

description2.plain: Innate: Pyke gains 1 bonus movement speed while in the river.

description3.plain: Innate: Pyke stores 9% (+ 0.2% per 1 Lethality) of the post-mitigation damage he takes from enemy champions as grey health on his health bar, increased to 40% (+ 0.4% per 1 Lethality) while there are two or more visible enemy champions nearby. He can store up to 80 (+ 800% bonus AD) grey health, with an upper cap of 55% of his maximum health.

description4.plain: While Pyke is not visible to enemies, he rapidly consumes his grey health to heal for the same amount.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Pyke}} {{tip|channel|charges}} up to a short time, increasing the {{sti|range}} of his harpoon. After a brief period, it becomes empowered with a new effect.
params.blurb2: ''Bone Skewer'' can be recast within the duration, and will cancel automatically afterwards, refunding a portion of the {{sti|mana|{{as|mana cost}}}}.
params.blurb3:
{{sbc|Recast:}} '''Pyke''' thrusts his blade in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the closest enemy {{tip|champion}} or closest enemy otherwise.

{{sbc|Empowered Recast:}} '''Pyke''' hurls his harpoon in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit and {{tip|airborne|pulls}} them towards him. The target is then briefly {{tip|slow|slowed}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Pyke''' {{tip|channel|charges}} while being {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 20% for up to 3 seconds to increase ''Bone Skewer's'' {{sti|range}} over the first second of the channel. ''Bone Skewer'' can be recast within the duration.
params.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Pyke''' hurls his harpoon in the target direction, becoming {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} while it is in flight and dealing {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit and {{tip|airborne|pulling}} them, during which they are also {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}, then {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 90% for 1 second.
params.description3: Releasing the ability within {{fd|0.4}} seconds causes '''Pyke''' to instead thrust his blade in the target direction, dealing the same damage to the closest enemy {{tip|champion}}, or closest enemy otherwise.
params.description4: If the charge is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} or completes without reactivation, ''Bone Skewer'' is cancelled and the ability is put on {{sti|cd|full}} cooldown but refunds {{sti|mana|{{as|75% of the mana cost}}}}. ''Bone Skewer's'' {{as|mana cost}} is also refunded if it hits an enemy champion.
params.target range: {{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{pp|type=channel time|400;400 to 1100 for 7|0;0.4 to 1|formula=400+(116.67 per 0.1 seconds, starting at 0.4 seconds). ''This is capped at 1 second.''}}

blurb.plain: Active: Pyke charges up to a short time, increasing the range of his harpoon. After a brief period, it becomes empowered with a new effect.

blurb2.plain: Bone Skewer can be recast within the duration, and will cancel automatically afterwards, refunding a portion of the mana cost.

blurb3.plain:
Recast: Pyke thrusts his blade in the target direction that deals physical damage to the closest enemy champion or closest enemy otherwise. 
Empowered Recast: Pyke hurls his harpoon in the target direction that deals physical damage to the first enemy hit and pulls them towards him. The target is then briefly slowed.

description.plain: Active: Pyke charges while being slowed by 20% for up to 3 seconds to increase Bone Skewer's range over the first second of the channel. Bone Skewer can be recast within the duration.

description2.plain: Recast: Pyke hurls his harpoon in the target direction, becoming unable to act while it is in flight and dealing physical damage to the first enemy hit and pulling them, during which they are also revealed, then slowing them by 90% for 1 second.

description3.plain: Releasing the ability within 0.4 seconds causes Pyke to instead thrust his blade in the target direction, dealing the same damage to the closest enemy champion, or closest enemy otherwise.

description4.plain: If the charge is interrupted or completes without reactivation, Bone Skewer is cancelled and the ability is put on full cooldown but refunds 75% of the mana cost. Bone Skewer's mana cost is also refunded if it hits an enemy champion.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Pyke}} submerges into water, entering {{tip|camouflage}} and gaining a burst of {{as|{{sti|movement speed}}}} for a few seconds. Nearby enemies are alerted of his presence.
params.blurb2: Attacking or casting abilities ends ''Ghostwater Dive'' immediately.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Pyke''' submerges into water for 5 seconds, entering {{tip|camouflage}} and gaining {{sti|ms|{{as|45%|ms}} {{as|(+ 2% per 1 Lethality)}} {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays over the duration. Attacking or casting abilities ends ''Ghostwater Dive'' immediately.
params.description2: ''Enemy champions within 1500 units of '''Pyke''' are alerted of his presence and whether he can execute them with {{ai|Death from Below|Pyke}}.''
params.flavorsound: {{sm2|Pyke Original W SFX 0.ogg}} ''Dive alert.'' {{sm2|Pyke Original W SFX 1.ogg}} ''Execute alert.''
params.notes:
* When an enemy is alerted, sharks will circle underneath their feet while a sound will be played to them that changes based on health threshold.
* Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the end of the attack windup.
* {{pending for test}} While submerged, a unique visual indicator will appear above '''Pyke''' if there are enemy champions closer than 700 units but farther than 600 units.

blurb.plain: Active: Pyke submerges into water, entering camouflage and gaining a burst of movement speed for a few seconds. Nearby enemies are alerted of his presence.

blurb2.plain: Attacking or casting abilities ends Ghostwater Dive immediately.

description.plain: Active: Pyke submerges into water for 5 seconds, entering camouflage and gaining 45% (+ 2% per 1 Lethality) bonus movement speed that decays over the duration. Attacking or casting abilities ends Ghostwater Dive immediately.

description2.plain: Enemy champions within 1500 units of Pyke are alerted of his presence and whether he can execute them with Death from Below.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Pyke}} dashes in the target direction, leaving behind a phantom and becoming {{tip|ghosted}}.
params.blurb2: After a brief period, the phantom homes back to '''Pyke''' to briefly {{tip|stun}} enemies it passes through. Enemy {{tip|champions}} hit also take {{as|physical damage}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Pyke''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} in the target direction, leaving behind a ''Phantom''. '''Pyke''' is {{tip|ghosted}} while the ''Phantom'' is active.
params.description2: After 1 second, the ''Phantom'' homes back to '''Pyke''' to {{tip|stun}} enemies around it and those it passes through along the way for {{fd|1.25}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.1}} per 10 Lethality)}} seconds. Enemy champions hit also take {{as|physical damage}}.
params.effect radius: {{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|110|Phantom unit checking for nearby units}}
params.speed: {{tt|3000|Both dash and returning phantom's missile speed}}
params.notes:
* The {{tip|dash}} distance can be extended to up to 900 units (estimated) when targeting across terrain.
* Like most [[missiles|projectiles]], the flying ''Phantom'' cannot hit targets whose {{tip|center range|center}} is behind the position it originates at or beyond the position it catches up to '''Pyke''' at, but the spell ''can'' hit targets behind its origin as long as their {{tip|edge range|hitbox radius}} overlaps with the original unit ''Phantom's'' 110-radius check at the end of its lifespan.

blurb.plain: Active: Pyke dashes in the target direction, leaving behind a phantom and becoming ghosted.

blurb2.plain: After a brief period, the phantom homes back to Pyke to briefly stun enemies it passes through. Enemy champions hit also take physical damage.

description.plain: Active: Pyke dashes in the target direction, leaving behind a Phantom. Pyke is ghosted while the Phantom is active.

description2.plain: After 1 second, the Phantom homes back to Pyke to stun enemies around it and those it passes through along the way for 1.25 (+ 0.1 per 10 Lethality) seconds. Enemy champions hit also take physical damage.

speed.note: Both dash and returning phantom's missile speed

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Pyke}} strikes the target location in a X pattern, which {{tip|execute|executes}} enemy {{tip|champions}} hit that are {{as|at low health}}. Other enemies hit are instead dealt {{as|physical damage}}.
params.blurb2: If ''Death from Below'' hits an enemy {{tip|champion}}, '''Pyke''' will {{tip|blink}} to the location. If an enemy champion dies inside the X, ''Death from Below'' can be recast within a period of time at no cost.
params.blurb3: Each execution grants {{g|kill gold}} to both '''Pyke''' and the last assisting ally instead of the natural assist gold.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Pyke''' marks the target location with the shape of an ''X'' before striking it, {{tip|execute|executing}} enemy {{tip|champions}} within the area that are below {{as|{{pp|250;290;330;370;400;430;450;470;490;510;530;540;550|6 to 18}}|health}} {{as|(+ 80% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{fd|1.5}} per 1 Lethality)}} {{sti|{{as|health}}}}. Other enemies hit and enemy champions above the threshold are instead dealt{{ft|50% of the amount as {{as|physical damage}}.|{{as|{{pp|125;145;165;185;200;215;225;235;245;255;265;270;275|6 to 18}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ 40% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.75}} per 1 Lethality)}} {{as|physical damage}}.}}
params.description2: If ''Death from Below'' hits an enemy {{tip|champion}} or at least one is [[death|killed]] inside the ''X'' by the ''execution'' or an ally, '''Pyke''' will {{tip|blink}} to the center of the ''X''. For the latter case '''Pyke''' can also recast the ability within 20 seconds at no cost.
params.description3: Each successful ''execution'' grants one ''{{ii|Your Cut}}'' to the last assisting ally, instead of its natural [[assist]] {{g|gold}}. Otherwise, '''Pyke''' is granted a ''{{ii|Your Cut}}'' for each enemy champion killed inside the ''X'' by an ally during ''Death from Below's'' cast time.
params.effect radius: {{dv|{{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|125|Circle check in the center}}|{{tt|{{fd|282.5}}{{times}}100|Arms length x width, Direction of arms 45° off the coordinate axes}}}}
params.notes:
* Applies {{tip|raw damage}} to executed targets and {{tip|area damage}} to targets above the threshold.
* ''Death from Below's'' execute against an enemy champion will aggro nearby enemy minions.
* ''Death from Below'' cannot execute {{tip|clone|clones}}. They are always dealt 50% {{as|physical damage}}.
* If the target is in a {{tip|zombie state}}, does not enter the {{tip|death}} state, or is killed by the ability while ''above'' the execution threshold, ''Death from Below'' does not grant {{ii|Your Cut}} nor the recast.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} does not prevent '''Pyke''' from {{tip|blink|blinking}}.
* ''Death from Below'' cannot be {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}; '''Pyke''' will always appear at the target location if enemy champions are caught inside the ''X'' even if he is moved (e.g. by being {{tip|airborne|displaced}}) during the cast time.
** The only exception is if he is being {{tip|suppression|suppressed}}, in which case he will not {{tip|blink}}.
* {{ri|Axiom Arcanist}} does not refund the cooldown while '''Pyke''' is able to recast.{{bug|2}}
** {{ri|Axiom Arcanist|Axiom Arcanist's}} tooltip counts it refunding ''Death from Below'' even when it doesn't.{{bug}}
* ''Death from Below'' will not go on cooldown if '''Pyke''' dies during its cast.
** '''Pyke''' will still generate {{ii|Your Cut}} from enemies that die inside the ''X'' before '''Pyke''' dies.

blurb.plain: Active: Pyke strikes the target location in a X pattern, which executes enemy champions hit that are at low health. Other enemies hit are instead dealt physical damage.

blurb2.plain: If Death from Below hits an enemy champion, Pyke will blink to the location. If an enemy champion dies inside the X, Death from Below can be recast within a period of time at no cost.

blurb3.plain: Each execution grants kill gold gold to both Pyke and the last assisting ally instead of the natural assist gold.

description.plain: Active: Pyke marks the target location with the shape of an X before striking it, executing enemy champions within the area that are below 250 – 550 (based on level) (+ 80% bonus AD) (+ 1.5 per 1 Lethality) health. Other enemies hit and enemy champions above the threshold are instead dealt 50% of the amount as physical damage.

description2.plain: If Death from Below hits an enemy champion or at least one is killed inside the X by the execution or an ally, Pyke will blink to the center of the X. For the latter case Pyke can also recast the ability within 20 seconds at no cost.

description3.plain: Each successful execution grants one Your Cut to the last assisting ally, instead of its natural assist gold gold. Otherwise, Pyke is granted a Your Cut for each enemy champion killed inside the X by an ally during Death from Below's cast time.
